description: This file contains unit tests for the ValidateUtil class within the OpenMRS project, specifically testing validation methods such as validate, validateFieldLengths, and validation disabling features. It uses JUnit 5 for testing and mocks validation scenarios for various domain objects.

classes.name: ValidateUtilTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing various validation functionalities of ValidateUtil in the OpenMRS core.

methods.name: validate_shouldThrowValidationExceptionIfErrorsOccurDuringValidation
methods.description: Tests that validation throws a ValidationException when errors occur during validation of a Location object.

methods.name: validate_shouldThrowAPIExceptionIfErrorsOccurDuringValidation
methods.description: Verifies that a ValidationException is thrown and contains errors when validating a Location object with errors.

methods.name: validate_shouldReturnImmediatelyIfValidationIsDisabled
methods.description: Ensures that validation returns immediately without error if validation disabling is enabled.

methods.name: validate_shouldReturnImmediatelyIfValidationIsDisabledForThread
methods.description: Checks validation behavior when validation is disabled for the current thread.

methods.name: validateFieldLength_shouldRejectValueWhenNameIsToLong
methods.description: Tests that a field error is added when the name exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: validateFieldLength_shouldNotRejectValueWhenNameIsEqualMax
methods.description: Ensures no error is added when name length equals maximum allowed length.

methods.name: validateFieldLength_shouldReturnImmediatelyIfValidationIsDisabledAndHaveNoErrors
methods.description: Checks that validation for field lengths is skipped if validation is disabled and no errors exist.

methods.name: validate_shouldPopulateErrorsIfObjectInvalid
methods.description: Verifies that errors are populated when an object is invalid during validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldReturnImmediatelyIfValidationIsDisabledAndHaveNoErrors
methods.description: Ensures no errors are added when validation is disabled and object is valid.

methods.name: validate_shouldReturnThrowExceptionAlongWithAppropriateMessageIfTheObjectIsInvalid
methods.description: Tests that validate throws a ValidationException with a message when an object (Drug) fails validation due to exceeding length constraints.
